envelope.description: The other seventeen tools: typebox, output schemas and per-input approval classes

body.title: The other seventeen tools: typebox, output schemas and per-input approval classes
body.summary: For git_stage, git_commit, git_amend, git_push, git_pull, git_fetch, git_reset, git_merge, git_rebase, git_revert, git_cherry-pick, git_checkout, git_branch, git_tag, git_stash, git_worktree and git_remote rewrite inputSchema as typebox with identical JSON, declare outputSchema, apply assertSafeArg and terminators, and set approval as a function of the input: destructive for hard reset, force or plus-prefixed or colon-delete push, branch and tag delete, stash drop and clear, worktree remove with force, checkout of a path or with discard; common otherwise, none for reads such as branch, tag, stash, worktree and remote listing. Post-mutation secondary reads (commit numstat, stage, revert, checkout, cherry-pick) keep placeholders and add data.warnings; precondition reads (git_reset and git_push lookups) fail the call before any change. Add the grep test that pins the inventory of ignored secondary lookups. Reject empty git_stage paths and git_fetch depth below 1.
acceptanceChecks: All 22 existing git tools (the five of t4 and these seventeen) declare an outputSchema
Every destructive operation listed in the LLD asks in every mode, including auto, and is not run when declined
Every non-destructive mutation and read resolves to common or none as listed
A failed post-mutation secondary read leaves the mutation's result successful with data.warnings; a failed precondition read fails before anything changes
The grep test fails when an ignored secondary lookup is added that the inventory does not list
Typebox input schemas serialise to the same JSON as before

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-approval.test.ts: each work-destroying operation is destructive and each read is none

src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-approval.test.ts: git_push deletes and forced refspecs, branch and tag delete, stash drop and clear, hard reset, worktree remove with force and checkout of a path are destructive and each read is none
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-tools-integration.test.ts: destructive git calls ask through the executor and are not run when declined
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-tools-integration.test.ts: git_push ':dev' asks in auto mode and is not run when declined
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-tools-integration.test.ts: an existing tool called with its old input returns what it returned before
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-tools-integration.test.ts: git_fetch depth 0 and 0.5 are rejected and git_fetch depth 1 runs as before
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-failures.test.ts: a failing git_commit numstat read after a successful commit is a success with a warning
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-failures.test.ts: every secondary lookup in the git tools is in the inventory and warns on failure

src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-failures.test.ts: a failing precondition read fails the call before any change, and no runShell or helper result is used outside failureKind, a warning or a listed placeholder

src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-failures.test.ts: git_amend wasPushed, git_reset willNeedForcePush and git_merge listConflicts keep their expected non-zero answers and fail or warn on process failures
